Royal Northern College of Music GREAT Scholarships 2023 is an opportunity offered by the Royal Northern College of Music in partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign. Two scholarships will be offered to postgraduate candidates in India. The selected candidates will receive financial support of a minimum of £10,000 for their one-year postgraduate study in the UK.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
be 18 years of age by 31 December in the year of entry
have a high level of performing/composition ability
have been classified as Overseas for fee status
have applied for a one-year full-time master's course such as Master of Music, Master of Performance, and Postgraduate Diploma
A total of two scholars will be selected from India who will receive £10,000.
